items.entity: design domain representation (full structure vs. symmetric half)
items.description: Sec. 7.1.1 only says the domain, BCs and load 'are shown in Fig. 6(a)'. The text fixes a 100×100 bilinear-quad mesh (Sec. 5, Sec. 8), and with top88's square unit elements that makes the analysis domain square. It does not say whether this square is the whole mid-loaded structure or one symmetric half, as in top88's default half-MBB beam, which the name 'mid-load' could also describe.
readings: Whole structure: 100×100-element square, load at mid-span, no symmetry reduction
Symmetric half: 100×100 domain = half of a 200×100 MBB-type beam with the symmetry plane on one vertical edge (top88 default run with nelx = nely = 100)

items.entity: physical dimensions, element size and out-of-plane thickness
items.description: No physical side length, element size or thickness is given. Only the 100×100 element count is stated (Sec. 5). top88 works in units of element size with unit thickness.
readings: 100 × 100 length units, unit square elements, unit thickness (top88 convention)
Physical size e.g. 1 m × 1 m (h = 0.01 m), any thickness, with rmin kept at 2.4 element widths (0.024 m)

items.description: Where the supports are and how far they extend is shown only in Fig. 6(a). Sec. 7.1.1 and Sec. 4.1 say nothing about them.
readings: Single nodes at both bottom corners (x/L = 0 and x/L = 1, y/H = 0) of the full square
Short patches (a few nodes, ~1–3% of L) at both bottom corners
Entire left and right edges (x/L = 0 and x/L = 1) – fixed–fixed beam
Half model: whole symmetry edge (x/L = 0) plus the single bottom-right corner node (x/L = 1, y/H = 0)

items.description: The text never says whether the supports are pins, rollers or clamps. This is conveyed only by Fig. 6(a).
readings: Pin (ux = uy = 0) at one bottom corner and roller (uy = 0) at the other
Pins (ux = uy = 0) at both bottom corners
Clamped (ux = uy = 0) along the supported edges
Half model: ux = 0 along the symmetry edge + vertical roller uy = 0 at the outer bottom corner (top88 default MBB)

items.description: The name 'mid-load' (Fig. 6(a) caption, Sec. 7.1.1) suggests mid-span, but which edge or point the load acts on is shown only in Fig. 6(a).
readings: Top-edge midpoint (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 1)
Bottom-edge midpoint (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 0)
Domain centre (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 0.5)
Half model: top corner on the symmetry edge (x/L = 0, y/H = 1), i.e. top88's default MBB load

items.description: The text does not say whether the load is a single nodal force or is spread over a short segment or a few elements. Only the Fig. 6(a) sketch shows it.
readings: Single nodal point force (top88 style)
Uniform traction over a short segment (e.g. 2–4 element widths ≈ 0.02–0.04 L) centred on the load point

items.description: The load direction is never stated; it appears only as the arrow in Fig. 6(a). Flipping the sign does not change the compliance-optimal layout, but vertical versus horizontal does.
readings: Vertical (−y, downward), normal to the loaded edge
Horizontal (±x)

items.description: No load magnitude is given anywhere (Sec. 4.1, 5, 7.1.1). top88's default is a unit force.
readings: |F| = 1 (top88 default, F = −1 in y)
Any physical value, e.g. |F| = 1 kN

items.description: Passive regions are never mentioned for this example. If there are any, they appear only in the domain sketch of Fig. 6(a).
readings: None – all 100×100 elements are designable (top88 default)
Small solid non-design pads under the load point and/or at the supports

items.description: Eq. (3) introduces E1 (solid) but gives no value. Watch the notation: in the paper E0 is the void modulus, while in top88 E0 is the solid modulus and Emin is the void one.
readings: E1 = 1 (top88 default E0 = 1)
Physical value, e.g. E1 = 210 GPa

items.entity: void Young's modulus E0 (Emin) in modified SIMP
items.description: Eq. (3) uses a void-phase modulus E0, but no value or E0/E1 ratio is given anywhere.
readings: E0 = 1e-9·E1 (top88 Emin)

items.description: No Poisson's ratio is stated in Sec. 4 or anywhere else; top88's default is 0.3.
readings: ν = 0.3 (top88 default)

items.description: Plane stress versus plane strain is not stated. Sec. 4 only says 'bi-linear quadrilateral' elements, and top88's element matrix is plane stress with unit thickness. Plane strain changes the effective Poisson's ratio.
readings: Plane stress (top88 element stiffness)
Plane strain

items.description: Sec. 5 gives only the top88 input flags {penal=3, rmin=2.4, ft=1} and never names the filter. In top88, ft=1 means sensitivity filtering (ft=2 means density filtering), and rmin is in element widths with linear cone weights.
readings: Sensitivity filter (top88 ft=1), cone weights, rmin = 2.4 element widths
Density filter, rmin = 2.4 element widths (physical density = filtered density)

items.entity: optimizer, move limit and initial design
items.description: The update scheme, move limit, damping and initial densities are not stated. They are implied only by the citation of top88 (Sec. 4.1, 7.1.1).
readings: top88 OC: move = 0.2, damping exponent 0.5, bisection on the Lagrange multiplier, uniform initial ρ = V_f
MMA with uniform initial ρ = V_f

items.description: No convergence tolerance or iteration cap is given for the top88 runs. maxit = 100 is listed in Sec. 5 only for TOPress.
readings: top88 default: stop when max|Δρ| < 0.01, no iteration cap
Fixed cap of 100 iterations (by analogy with the TOPress setting)
Cap of 200 iterations with tolerance 0.01
